title: sigelo/0 rotation envelope
description: A rotation as it travels in a bundle (SPEC §3, §7, §8): body, sig and next_genesis are all required; a missing one is fatal to the bundle (SPEC §7.4). No other key: SPEC §3.1, an envelope is exactly its defined members, and a rotation envelope carrying another is fatal like a missing one (vector fatal_rotation_envelope_extra_key).
